row.team_price_text: Tenable One Vulnerability Management: $3,700/yr for 100 assets (asset-priced)
row.evidence: Tenable One Vulnerability Management's SAML docs say automatic account provisioning creates an account "the first time they log in via the IdP" and that users "are not pre-populated by group assignment in the IdP"; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: New row. Researched Tenable One Vulnerability Management (cloud.tenable.com), the platform the other Tenable One modules share; Security Center and Nessus are on-premises. Pricing is per asset, not per user: $3,700 for a 1-year subscription at 100 assets on the buy page; Tenable One Exposure Management and other products are quote-only. SAML SSO is part of the product, with optional just-in-time 'User Autoprovisioning' (Basic role by default, optional userRoleUuid and group mapping via SAML attributes); there is no SCIM endpoint and no documented SAML deprovisioning. The REST API (X-ApiKeys) can create, update, disable, re-enable and delete users and manage groups and roles. Okta's 'Tenable.io' catalogue app is SWA only.

plans.name: Tenable One Vulnerability Management
plans.price_text: $3,700 per 1-year subscription (100 assets); online purchase up to 250 assets
plans.notes: Asset-priced; Nessus Professional/Expert and Web App Scanning are separate products. Other Tenable One products are quote-only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the Tenable docs sitemap (13,600 URLs), the full Tenable Vulnerability Management user guide PDF, or the developer portal; user provisioning is SAML just-in-time ('User Autoprovisioning') only. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

auth.notes: X-ApiKeys header (accessKey/secretKey); endpoints require the Administrator [64] role or matching custom-role privileges.

rate_limits.text: Per-user (per API key) per-minute limit set dynamically by platform load; 429 with retry-after header.

okta.notes: OIN 'Tenable.io' app (last updated Apr. 2020) ticks only SWA (read from page markup). Tenable's docs use a per-container Okta SAML app integration.

entra.notes: No Tenable entry in Microsoft Learn's SaaS tutorial index; docs reference a Tenable enterprise application configured for SAML.

google.notes: Custom SAML app per Tenable docs.
